pages.text: “Serene and vibrant, nourishing both body and soul, revitalizing strength.”$(br2)Lily Tea is a soothing and nourishing tea made from dried lily petals and sugar. Drinking it grants a Max Health boost, making travelers more resilient.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Lily Tea, $(br)boil dried lily petals with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed before battles or adventures, providing additional vitality for travelers.

Upon drinking Lily Tea, travelers receive a Max Health boost, making their bodies more resilient.$(br)This is an ideal tea for combat and challenging encounters.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
